limitations: Manifest/config inspection does not pull all image layers or repeat security and GPU qualification.
HTTP 401/403 means anonymous access was not verified; it does not prove an image is absent.
Missing producer revisions leave source parity unproven; an inherited OCI revision label is only a hint.
